Do you require a deposit to get started?
Yes. A 50% payment is required before the design and development of a custom piece begins. Deposits are taken by wire, Zelle or Cash App.
How long does a custom pendant take?
Every piece has its own production time. Design, quality and the materials used all change the schedule, so JoJo confirms a timeline with you once the design is approved.
What payment methods do you accept?
Cash, secure credit and debit card payments, and bank transfers.
